verdict.rationale: Slack ships its own automation layer. Workflow Builder lets any user combine steps and triggers to set up an automation, webhook triggers start workflows from outside Slack without a person present, and developers can write Slack-hosted workflows in TypeScript. Together these cover background automations that run without user involvement. missing for 10: evidence of recurring/scheduled triggers, evidence of AI agents acting autonomously in the background rather than on request, independent or hands-on corroboration, and depth beyond Workflow Builder's 'limited set of steps'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Any user can combine a limited set of steps and triggers to quickly set up an automation.
